content:
The latest WhatsApp beta available on TestFlight brings back message animations on iOS, this time with a setting that lets users turn them off. Here are the details.

Message animations coming back to WhatsApp

As spotted by WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is working to bring back message animations on iOS.

The news comes a week after the same setting rolled out in WhatsApp’s Android beta, and it adds Messages as an option that can be turned on or off in 

Settings > Chats > Animations
, alongside switches for Emoji, Stickers, and GIFs.

From WABetaInfo:

The site notes that rather than “simply popping into place,” the message bubble “now fades in while slightly scaling up as it settles into the conversation with the new animation.”

As with most features introduced through WhatsApp’s TestFlight beta, message animations are currently available to only a limited number of testers.

There is no word on when they will roll out publicly, but with testing now underway on both iOS and Android, an official launch may not be that far off.
